record.issue_text: If CALCOM_WEBHOOK_HEADER_NAME is set with uppercase characters, Node's lowercased incoming headers will never match — fail-closed but a configuration footgun

adjudication.rationale: In `apps/web/pages/api/webhook/app-credential.ts`, the secret check indexes `req.headers[...]` using `process.env.CALCOM_WEBHOOK_HEADER_NAME` verbatim: `req.headers[process.env.CALCOM_WEBHOOK_HEADER_NAME || "calcom-webhook-secret"] !== process.env.CALCOM_WEBHOOK_SECRET`. In Node/Next, incoming header keys on `req.headers` are normalized to lowercase, so if `CALCOM_WEBHOOK_HEADER_NAME` contains any uppercase characters (e.g., `X-Calcom-Webhook-Secret`), the lookup will miss even when the request includes the correct header. This makes the endpoint reject valid requests due to header name case, which is a real behavior defect (HTTP header names are case-insensitive).
